<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="migrating-to-lexphon-0-2">
<h1>Migrating to Lexphon 0.2</h1>
<p>Lexphon 0.2 is a breaking API cleanup. The release makes provider behavior typed and explicit, exposes structured pronunciation variants, and separates Lexphon lexicon provisioning from optional provider provisioning.</p>
<section id="api-mapping">
<h2>API mapping</h2>
<table class="docutils align-default">
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>Lexphon 0.1 behavior</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Lexphon 0.2 replacement</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Legacy fallback compatibility APIs</p></td>
<td><p>Strict <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PronunciationProvider</span></code> and typed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProviderError</span></code> subclasses</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">variant_details</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Structured <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PronunciationToken.variants</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PronunciationVariant</span></code></p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">alphabet</span></code></p></td>
<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_encoding</span></code> at the provider or token boundary, with normalized IPA output</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>Direct lookup miss with implicit fallback semantics</p></td>
<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> for a genuine direct miss; providers are invoked only after lexicon misses</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Legacy CLI JSON output</p></td>
<td><p>CLI JSON schema 2 with structured token and provenance fields</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>Scalar-only optional provider usage</p></td>
<td><p>Optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BatchPronunciationProvider</span></code> support through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lookup_many()</span></code></p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>Implicit or ambiguous default lexicon configuration</p></td>
<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lexicons=None</span></code> for profile defaults and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lexicons=[]</span></code> for provider-only construction</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
<section id="provider-and-lexicon-configuration">
<h2>Provider and lexicon configuration</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lexicons=None</span></code> opens the language profile’s default lexicons and requires those assets to be installed. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lexicons=[]</span></code> opens no lexicon layers and is the explicit provider-only configuration. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lookup_many()</span></code> checks configured lexicons first, sends only misses to a batch provider when available, preserves input order, and requires one output per submitted miss.</p>
<p>Provider output is normalized at the Lexphon engine boundary. A provider may return <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">str</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> for scalar calls and a sequence of those values for batch calls. Malformed output raises <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProviderOutputError</span></code>; provider execution failures raise <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProviderExecutionError</span></code>.</p>
<p>Install optional provider dependencies explicitly:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;lexphon[espeak]&quot;</span>
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;lexphon[goruut]&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The eSpeak extra does not install the system executable. Pygoruut may provision its own Goruut runtime. A pre-populated <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LEXPHON_DATA_HOME</span></code> only removes Lexphon catalog and lexicon downloads; it does not guarantee offline startup of an optional provider.</p>
</section>
<section id="kokorog2p-adapter-example">
<h2>KokoroG2P adapter example</h2>
<p>A 0.1 adapter commonly relied on implicit profile defaults and scalar provider calls:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Phonemizer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;de-DE&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fallback</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;espeak&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">engine</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">token</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">engine</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lookup</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">word</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">token</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">convert_ipa_to_kokoro</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pronunciation</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="s2">&quot;&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>In 0.2, choose the lexicon behavior explicitly and preserve typed provider results at the adapter boundary:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">lexphon</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Phonemizer</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">lexphon.errors</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">ProviderError</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">Phonemizer</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;de-DE&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">lexicons</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&quot;de-de:gold&quot;</span><span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="n">fallback</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;espeak&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">engine</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">token</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">engine</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lookup</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">word</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">except</span> <span class="n">ProviderError</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">error</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">LookupError</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Lexphon provider failed for </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">word</span><span class="si">!r}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">error</span>

<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">token</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">LookupError</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Lexphon miss for </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">word</span><span class="si">!r}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">convert_ipa_to_kokoro</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pronunciation</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="s2">&quot;&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>For provider-only operation, replace the lexicon list with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lexicons=[]</span></code>. For text batches, use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">engine.lookup_many(words)</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">engine.phonemize_tokens(text)</span></code> so token order, punctuation, variants, and provenance remain available to the downstream adapter.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
